ht-bbca-magang-bakti.d:
Tentang Pekerjaan

Program Permagangan Bakti (MGB) terbuka buat kamu yang ingin bergabung menjadi frontliner BCA. Kamu akan mendapatkan training dan pengalaman bekerja yang akan mempersiapkanmu menjadi seorang profesional.

Gambaran Pekerjaan:

Sebagai seorang Frontliner, kamu bertugas melayani serta memberikan solusi perbankan yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan nasabah. Posisi ini cocok untuk kamu yang ramah serta terampil. Kamu akan berinteraksi langsung dengan berbagai nasabah yang ada di kantor cabang BCA.

Benefit buat kamu!

Kamu akan mendapatkan training, uang saku setiap bulan, cuti, tunjangan kesehatan, dan di akhir program kamu akan mendapatkan sertifikat serta tunjangan beasiswa.

Informasi Seleksi:

BCA bekerjasama dengan PT Sentral Layanan Prima (SLP) & PT IFO CharCom Empowerment untuk proses seleksi Magang Bakti area Jabodetabek.

Pendaftaran Magang Bakti Jabodetabek wajib dilakukan secara online melalui web karir BCA. Informasi proses seleksi selanjutnya akan disampaikan melalui email rekrutmenbakti@pt-slp.co.id / recruitment@ifocharcom.com (lamaran yang dikirimkan melalui email tidak akan diproses lebih lanjut).

Hati-hati terhadap penipuan yang mengatasnamakan BCA.

Seluruh proses rekrutmen dan seleksi BCA tidak dipungut biaya apapun.

Persyaratan

• WNI, pria atau wanita berusia 18 s/d 24 tahun
• Lulusan SMA / SMK (nilai rata-rata rapor semester 5 & 6 min. 70)
• Lulusan D1 - D3 atau S1 (IPK min. 2,50)
• Senang berinteraksi dengan orang lain
• Ramah, terampil, solutif, teliti, dan mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik
• Belum pernah mengikuti Program Pemagangan Bakti BCA sebelumnya
• Belum menikah dan bersedia untuk tidak menikah selama program pemagangan

Job Purpose :
To provide actionable market, customer, and competitor insights that support strategic decision-making, enhance commercial performance, and strengthen the company's competitive positioning.

Main Responsibility :

• Analyze market trends, industry developments, and macroeconomic factors that may impact business performance and identify their implications for the organization.
• Conduct field surveys and market exploration to gather insights from relevant stakeholders, including RO Owners, customers, sales teams, and other business partners, to understand market conditions, customer needs, and business challenges.
• Monitor and analyze competitor strategies, products, offerings, campaigns, pricing, and go-to-market approaches, including benchmarking against internal products and market competitors.
• Develop a strong understanding of internal and competitor products, including product features, value propositions, pricing, and market positioning, to support comparative analysis and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Identify emerging market needs, customer behavior, industry trends, and potential business opportunities through both field research and analysis of internal and external data.
• Collect, validate, and analyze data from internal and external sources, combining quantitative data with field insights to generate meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
• Translate survey findings and market analysis into structured strategic reports and business recommendations for management, particularly for Regional General Managers (RGH) and Head of Sales (HOS).
• Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support annual business planning, forecasting, performance reviews, and strategic decision-making.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to validate findings, understand market dynamics, and ensure that recommendations are relevant to business needs.

Contract

su-excl-1369290166.d:
Job Purpose
Drive premium subscriber acquisition, maximize ARPU, and establish extreme customer stickiness by integrating world-class consumer ICT services into the telco’s core offerings. This role serves as the commercial lead for strategic partnerships with global tech giants (e.g., Apple, Google, Alibaba), successfully monetizing personal cloud storage, consumer AI, and premium entertainment ecosystems to position the telco as the ultimate gateway for advanced digital lifestyles.

Main Responsibility
Strategic ICT Partnership Management: Lead end-to-end commercial relationships and contract negotiations with global tier-1 technology partners (such as Apple for iCloud+/Arcade/TV, Google for Gemini/Cloud, and Alibaba for Personal Data Storage). Secure favorable revenue-share models, volume commitments, and exclusive B2C propositions.

Bundling & Proposition Development: Design and execute high-yield commercial bundles that integrate core telco connectivity with premium ICT services alongiside with Segment team. Develop hard-bundles, add-ons, and freemium-to-premium upgrade paths for consumer AI, cloud storage, and Apple ecosystem services to drive significant ARPU uplift.

Churn Mitigation via Ecosystem Stickiness: Capitalize on the inherently high retention value of personal data storage and integrated tech ecosystems. Collaborate with Customer Value Management (CVM) to target high-value subscriber segments, using ICT bundles as a strategic tool to heavily reduce churn and increase Customer Lifetime Value (CLV).

Joint Go-To-Market & Campaign Execution: Orchestrate co-branded marketing campaigns leveraging the intellectual property (IP) and Marketing Development fund of global tech partners. Align with internal marketing and GTM teams to ensure successful launches that drive mass adoption of consumer ICT services.

Cross-Functional Technical Integration: Serve as the business sponsor for the seamless technical onboarding of global ICT platforms. Work intimately with IT, Billing, and Network teams to ensure frictionless API integrations, automated provisioning, and a zero-defect billing experience for complex digital subscriptions.

Key Output
Premium Revenue & ARPU Growth: Achievement of targeted gross revenue and a measurable, sustained uplift in Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) directly attributed to the adoption of standalone and bundled consumer ICT services.

Maximized Subscriber Stickiness (Reduced Churn): A definitive, measurable drop in subscriber churn among the cohort of users actively engaging with highly retentive services like personal cloud storage and Apple ecosystem bundles.

Commercial Agreements: A finalized, active portfolio of profitable contracts with global tech mega-brands, featuring optimized commercial terms, margin protection, and robust joint-marketing commitments.

Scaled Consumer ICT Penetration: A defined percentage increase in subscriber attach rates and Monthly Active Users (MAU) for personal AI tools, cloud storage, and premium ecosystem subscriptions across the telco’s customer base.

Key contact relationship internal

1. Segment Team: Product Construct, Bundling Design & Pricing Alignment
2. Marketing: Marketing investment, campaign strategy
3. ITBP: Integration & technical enablement
4. Finance: Commercial evaluation and new revenue stream validation
5. MSA: Performance & Analytics

Key contact relationship External

1. Ecosystem Partners: Agreement, MOU

Qualification

S1 (Strata 1) degree in Marketing is minimum requirements.
S2 (Strata 2) degree in Marketing is preferred

Minimum 5-7 Years experience in Telecommunication, Sales & Distribution, Business Administration roles

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

wo-klbf-JR26_000517.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Perform quality assurance tasks
- Handle equipment inspections
- Troubleshoot quality issues
- Ensure compliance with quality standards
- Maintain equipment and tools

- Melakukan tugas jaminan kualitas
- Menangani inspeksi peralatan
- Memecahkan masalah kualitas
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar kualitas
- Memelihara peralatan dan alat

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
